## The design in one paragraph

Since `voice-unified-papercup-pipeline-2026-07-01` (owner-ratified D-001..D-004), the
**zellij pane's psu Papercup is the ONE brain of record for every modality**. Typed text
and voice both enter through `writeToSentinelPane` (`papercup/papercup-pane-input.ts`,
formerly `sentinel/sentinel-pane-input.ts` before the sentinel→papercup rename —
the shared mechanics behind `POST /operator/papercup-input`), and every Papercup answer
leaves both **written** (pane text) and **spoken** (`voice:say` → `sentinel_says` FIFO →
the says-pump). ElevenLabs Conv-AI is deliberately **demoted to a voice front-end**:
STT, the Herald voice, turn-taking, barge-in — never a brain.

## The relay (voice-in)

`operator-voice-session.ts` relays **every final `user_transcript` event** to the pane
deterministically — in our code, NOT dependent on the EL agent's LLM choosing to call a
tool. The EL `ask_operator` client tool no longer runs a brain: it returns only
`VOICE_RELAY_ACK` ("On it — I'll come back to you in a moment") for EL to speak, or a
spoken failure line (`relayFailureLine`) when the relay is known to have missed
(no dock / exited pane / write failure). A tool call with no preceding transcript is a
fallback relay, deduped against an identical same-turn transcript relay.

The old second brain — `askOperator` → `${role}:converse` in
`operator-voice-session-deps.ts` — is **deleted**. That path was the modality
split-brain: voice answered from an in-process converse turn while typed text went to
the pane, so the two modalities had different conversation state.

## The says-pump (voice-out)

While a voice session is LIVE, `voice-node/sentinel-says-pump.ts` (not yet renamed to
the `papercup-` prefix, unlike the pane-input/deep-delegate/deep-watch modules below)
drains the pane's
`voice:say` lines from PG (`harness_shared.sentinel_says`, migration 390) server-side,
broadcasts each as a **response transcript** (clients display it) and synthesizes it
into **bus audio** via the same `speakIntoSession` seam the proactive sweep uses
(`synthesize` → WAV → PCM → `broadcastOpVoice`), then persists it to the shared thread.
Every attached client (webview, TUI) sees + the elected player hears the same answer.

**The single-consumer gate is the load-bearing subtlety.** The FIFO has TWO possible
consumers: this pump, and the webview's legacy local-mode poll
(`VoiceAppBridge` → `GET /operator/papercup-output`). Exactly one may drain at a time:

- pump: gated on `sessionLive()` — it never touches the FIFO without a live session;
- webview poll: gated OFF while `micOwnedByFullAgent` (a session is live).

The PG drain (`DELETE … RETURNING`) is atomic, so a transition race delivers a line to
exactly one consumer — worst case it is spoken by the wrong engine once, never twice
and never lost. If you add a third consumer you must extend this gate, not race it.

## The deep-delegation lane

Hard thinking (an answer expected back in conversation) must not block the
conversational pane and must NOT go to the Mug (her wake loop places work; she is not
an answer channel — D-003). Two entry points, one core (`papercup/papercup-deep-delegate.ts`):

- pane runtime: the `voice:delegate_deep` MCP tool (`agent-tools/voice/delegate-deep.ts`);
- converse runtime: the `<delegate_deep summary brief>` tag (parsed in
  `operator-converse-tags.ts`, dispatched from `converse.ts`).

`delegateDeep` mints a `task`-kind work-item (tagged `deep-delegation`) **already claimed
by the pre-minted spawn id in the same write** (so it never sits unclaimed in the
placement frontier — no double-execution race), spawns an ephemeral deep-tier `cup` with
the question as its brief (cap 2 in flight, 15-min timeout, claim released back to `todo`
if the launch is refused), and the agent answers by COMPLETING the item —
`completion.summary` IS the answer. (WI-2874: the durable record used to be a
feature-family `research-task` kind; that was merged into the generic `task` kind since
research/analysis is non-code work.) On settle, `papercup/papercup-deep-watch.ts` (fired
from the work-items settled-events seam) injects `[deep-answer WI-NNN] <summary>` back
through `writeToSentinelPane`, with a hindsight fallback when the pane is down. The
Papercup never spawns anything itself — the SN-H04 no-spawn contract holds; the
tool/watch is the accountable, capped indirection.

## Traps

1. **The EL agent must be relay-shaped.** `resolveConfig` pushes `EL_RELAY_PERSONA` as
   a `conversation_config_override` — but EL only honors it when the agent's dashboard
   security settings allow prompt overrides. If the dashboard rejects it, the session
   silently runs the dashboard persona; keep THAT persona relay-shaped too, or the EL
   LLM will chat from its own knowledge and the split-brain returns at the edges.
2. **Do not "fix" the pump to run without a session.** With no session there is no
   elected player to render audio, and the webview local-mode poll owns the FIFO.
3. **The relay types real turns into the one dock.** Every voice utterance consumes a
   pane Claude turn, lands in the user-visible papercup pane, and rides the
   warm-up/exited-pane guards. Live testing therefore touches the user's dock — the
   full round-trip E2E is a coordinated (owner-present) run, not a silent CI job.
4. **Scenario coverage:** `sn-D01`/`sn-D02` enforce the three-way routing
   (answer / delegate / handoff); the host relay semantics are unit-tested in
   `operator-voice-session.test.ts`; the pump in `sentinel-says-pump.test.ts`.
